eligibility_rule: Eligible only when the UTC cutoff is at or after 365 calendar days from the later non-null caseClosedAt or lastParticipantActivityAt, and exclusions is empty. The result remains MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

provider_boundary.behavior: No provider identifier, provider-bound record, provider API call, or provider deletion operation is read or produced.

time_zone_behavior: Parse all timestamps as ISO-8601 UTC instants. Add the retention window with setUTCDate. Exact cutoff equality is eligible only when exclusions are empty.

missing_invalid_input_behavior.invalid_candidate_date: Reject the input with D-007 dry-run input includes an invalid date.
missing_invalid_input_behavior.invalid_cutoff: Reject the input with D-007 dry-run requires a valid as-of date.
missing_invalid_input_behavior.unknown_exclusion: Not admissible in this frozen mapping; no execution may run with a non-enumerated exclusion.

output_behavior: Aggregate only, exactly as d007-retention-aggregate-contract/v1 permits.
